inputs.original_text: Hyderabad: Bharat Rashtra Samithi (BRS) Working President KT Rama Rao (KTR) on Sunday, March 29, accused the Congress government of corruption and failing to act against illegal mining. KTR alleged that Raghava Constructions, a company belonging to Telangana Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy is involved in illegal mining. You can also download our app for Android and iOS .
inputs.modified_text: KTR’s allegation of illegal mining under the Congress government, involving a company allegedly belonging to Information and Public Relations Minister Ponguletti Srinivas Reddy, is a serious test of whether the law applies equally. When political connections appear to shield the powerful, ordinary citizens lose faith in authority and the rule of law. The government must ensure a firm, transparent investigation—no minister or party connection should put anyone above the rules.
